_comment: English body for grammarly; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by Grammarly’s generative writing capabilities; the product page does not publish a full model list, and features vary by tier.
axes.runtime: Available through web, browser extension, desktop client and mobile keyboard; text processing happens in the cloud.
axes.local_files: Primarily processes text in input fields, documents and uploaded files; local files enter through the client or an upload.
axes.background: Proofreading, rewriting and generation happen as you type or on request; there is no long-running agent that survives shutdown.
axes.tools: Integrates with browsers, Word, Google Docs, email clients and desktop apps; enterprise plans add style guides and team rules.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current document, sentence and team style guide; cross-document memory is limited. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Enterprise plans can control data retention, team rules and administrator policy; commercial use follows the tier and official terms.
axes.fit: Fits: English proofreading, tone adjustment and email polishing. Does not fit: native Chinese writing, deep fact-checking or data analysis.
